evidence_gaps: Runtime evidence is MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS with generated_epoch 0; fresh-within-2h is false.
No per-strategy, per-chain SHADOW windows containing cost-complete money-weighted NET P&L.
No per-trade Solana network fee, priority fee, Jupiter fee, price-impact, slippage, failed-attempt cost, and reconciled wallet-delta evidence.
No per-trade EVM gas, approval gas, builder payment, route fee, slippage, reverted-transaction cost, and final user-fee-adjusted P&L evidence.
No reproducible STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE terminal classification.
No quote-age, detection latency, submission latency, inclusion latency, exit latency, or counterfactual decision-time price evidence tied to trade outcomes.
No out-of-sample results, regime segmentation, capital-weighted drawdown, tail-loss, profit-factor confidence interval, or asset/leader concentration evidence.

Before any promotion: require fresh cost-complete SHADOW evidence meeting the proposal observation floors, positive net P&L and profit factor out of sample, bounded drawdown and concentration, reproducible loss attribution, and zero unresolved safety or reconciliation failures.

proposals.downside_risk: More detailed attribution may reduce apparent performance and requires careful avoidance of double-counting costs already embedded in wallet balance deltas.

evidence.detail: Window schema records fees and slippage_cost but has no mandatory gas, priority fee, price-impact leakage, failed-attempt cost, or profit-share fields.
Default net_profit is gross_profit minus gross_loss, fees, and slippage only.
EVM execution logs realised_net_base and profit_fee_base separately, so realised_net_base is not the final user net after profit fees.

proposals.expected_effect: SHADOW evaluation would rank strategies by economically complete net returns and prevent promotion caused by omitted Solana priority fees, EVM gas, execution leakage, failed transactions, or profit-share settlement costs.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 closed SHADOW trades and 5 independent windows per observed chain, including at least 5 rejected or failed executions, with 100% cost-field completeness.
proposals.rationale: Promotion decisions must use durable money-weighted user NET P&L after every economic cost. Optional caller-supplied net values are insufficient because incomplete cost attribution can make a losing strategy appear positive.
proposals.shadow_test: In SHADOW only, replay identical opportunities through the current and complete-cost ledgers. Require every trade to reconcile gross proceeds, principal, route/platform fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees, failed-attempt charges, and user fees. Stop and mark the test failed on any unexplained residual above 1% of total recorded costs or any trade whose cost-complete P&L changes sign without an attributable ledger item.

proposals.downside_risk: Conservative failure-cost and latency reserves can suppress valid opportunities when calibration data is sparse.

evidence.detail: MarketFeatures includes fees, slippage, price impact, and latency reserve in basis points but no explicit gas, Solana priority fee, failed-attempt reserve, or notional used to convert fixed costs.
net_edge_bps subtracts only the five currently represented components.
EVM live selection separately applies a gas-multiple floor, demonstrating that fixed chain costs cannot safely be represented by a universal static basis-point threshold.

proposals.expected_effect: Strategies would abstain unless chain-specific quotes and notional convert all fixed and variable costs into the same unit, improving net P&L without forcing trade frequency.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 eligible-or-near-threshold observations per chain across 7 days, plus at least 30 closed SHADOW round trips per chain where opportunities exist.
proposals.rationale: Solana priority fees and EVM gas are fixed or state-dependent native-token costs whose basis-point burden changes with notional. A common 3-6 bps edge floor can be positive while executable user net is negative, especially at low capital.
proposals.shadow_test: For every SHADOW signal, calculate edge twice: current generic bps and chain-specific executable net in native and USD terms. Solana must include quoted route/platform costs, measured priority/network fees, price impact and failure reserve; EVM must include current gas estimate, approval requirements, builder costs, slippage and failure reserve. Fail the hypothesis if chain-specific realised or simulated net is non-positive in more than 5% of signals classified eligible, or if any missing cost defaults to zero.

proposals.downside_risk: Causal labels can be misleading unless generated from immutable timestamps, quotes, receipts, and balance reconciliation rather than free-form error text.

evidence.detail: execution_failures is a count, while loss amount and execution costs are aggregated separately without a required causal classification.
EVM leader exits depend on quoted net thresholds, but exceptions may be swallowed and pending exits can remain exposed to further market movement.

Solana leader-return and realised-loss quarantines protect entry selection, but stale evidence provides no observed decomposition of copied-signal loss versus execution leakage or infrastructure failure.

proposals.expected_effect: Loss remediation would target the actual cause: rework signals for strategy losses while addressing RPC, routing, latency, or reconciliation only when execution evidence supports it.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 closed outcomes per strategy and chain, at least 5 execution-failure examples where naturally observed, and 95% or greater reproducible terminal classification across 5 independent windows.
proposals.rationale: A negative return after a correctly executed signal is STRATEGY/MARKET loss. Quote failure, stale detection, simulation or submission failure, abnormal inclusion delay, unexpected fee, reconciliation failure, or inability to exit is EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure. Counts alone cannot show their money-weighted effects.
proposals.shadow_test: Assign each SHADOW opportunity exactly one terminal class: NO_EDGE_ABSTAIN, STRATEGY_MARKET_LOSS, EXECUTION_INFRA_FAILURE, SUCCESS_NET_POSITIVE, or UNRESOLVED. Record counterfactual decision-time net, executable quote, timestamps, receipts, balance delta and all costs. Stop promotion assessment if UNRESOLVED exceeds 2%, if any failure cost is excluded from money-weighted P&L, or if classification cannot be reproduced from stored evidence.
proposals.strategy: Solana and EVM leader-copy and market-native strategies

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy because repository thresholds show positive net profit or profit factor.
rejected_ideas.reason: No fresh runtime windows exist, and current aggregation does not guarantee inclusion of every chain-specific cost.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or loosen liquidity, sellability, simulation, edge, reserve, stop-loss, or circuit-breaker controls.
rejected_ideas.reason: No executable profitability evidence supports additional exposure; inactivity without positive edge is preferable.

rejected_ideas.idea: Use leader win rate as the primary selection metric.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count is not money-weighted and can conceal rare large losses, follower-copy latency, and fixed execution costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat all negative P&L as a strategy defect.
rejected_ideas.reason: Execution failures, delayed or failed exits, fee overruns, and reconciliation faults require separate attribution.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository has useful fail-closed execution controls and money-weighted strategy evaluation, but Strategy Lab net P&L does not structurally require gas, priority fees, price impact, failed-attempt costs, or user profit fees. Cross-chain SHADOW features likewise omit explicit chain gas/priority costs. Consequently, strategy/market losses cannot yet be reliably separated from execution/infrastructure failures in promotion evidence. No profitability, CANARY-readiness, or LIVE-readiness claim is supported.
